design.shape: SupervisorIntegrationProposalV1 -> resolve_proposal_to_canonical -> SupervisorIntegrationDecisionV2 -> resolve_integration_proposal_v2 (UNCHANGED) -> IntegrationDecisionValidator (UNCHANGED) -> StateTransitionPolicy (UNCHANGED) -> FinalizationGate (UNCHANGED)

uniform_update_envelope.motivation: five per-entity update_* variants (question/evidence/hypothesis/contradiction/coverage) share the shape {handle, to_status, evidence operands, justification fields}; the entity KIND is exactly inferable from the handle prefix (COV/Q/E/H/X — bijective, no fuzzy matching)
uniform_update_envelope.effect: 10 action variants -> 6; 4 per-kind to_status enum-typed fields replaced by one string field validated at resolve time against the TARGET KIND's frozen enum (fail-closed, accepted set identical per kind)
uniform_update_envelope.question_only_fields: disposition/investigated_summary/blocker/superseded_by_handle remain expressible; rejected (P_FIELD_NOT_VALID_FOR_KIND) when the target kind is not question
uniform_update_envelope.trade_off: schema is less self-describing: the kind-field mapping must live in instructions (a prompt-side cost for any future RCA-2B implementation)

design.status_enums: statuses become plain strings in the schema; membership in the target kind's frozen enum enforced by the resolver (enforcement point moved schema-parse -> server-side resolve; accepted set identical, verified by equivalence tests). Creation enums (QuestionSource/QuestionPriority/ContradictionSeverity) are enforced at resolve time the same way.
design.identity: unchanged and structurally absent from the model surface (task/run/state identity injected from the frozen context exactly as the canonical path)
design.handles: pass through VERBATIM; prefix inference is exact; the binding table still validates existence + kind; no fuzzy repair, no auto-creation

measured_complexity.source: integration-schema-audit-v1.json (generated schemas, same transformer as the model-facing bridge)

explicit_non_claims: model reliability improvement is UNVERIFIED — the 11 historical INTEGRATE retry exhaustions have no persisted output-tool params or field-level errors (RCA-1 F-3/F-10), so nothing can claim the proposal would have prevented them
schema reduction does not imply reliability improvement (RCA-2A §7)
no production schema, prompt, policy or validator was modified

semantic_equivalence.summary: all ten canonical actions byte-equivalent through the unchanged canonical path; old-rejects imply new-rejects; one new rejection class (cross-kind fields) and two enforcement-point moves documented with identical accepted sets
